plannedVideo: Why did a football team deliberately score an own goal—then defend both goals—to qualify?
coldViewerPull: Scoring against yourself seems to sabotage winning. Protecting the opponent's goal makes the decision stranger still. What could make both actions sensible?
expectedPayoff: Understand why a2–1 win was insufficient, why equalizing unlocked a double-value extra-time goal, and why Grenada could then qualify by scoring at either end. A rule meant to settle matches reversed what rational play looked like.
